summary: Einride AB furnished a Form 6-K on October 9, 2026, attaching an updated corporate presentation as Exhibit 99.1. No transaction, stake, price, premium, or recommendation is stated. The filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer current report, the US equivalent of a Form 8-K, and discloses no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, divestiture, spin-off, or forced management change. No deal terms, advisors, or regulatory clocks are disclosed. Arbitrage or event-driven attention is not warranted; monitor future 6-K filings for substantive corporate actions.
